subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Acme Robotics) - post-demo MAP draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Acme Robotics) - post-demo MAP draft

Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the time and for walking through the evaluation needs. As discussed, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so we can align responsibilities and timing. High level recap below and asks for next steps.

MAP milestone - Vendor onboarding / procurement (owner in parentheses):
- Acme provides preferred procurement flow (Ariba or Coupa) and supplier onboarding form (Acme) (Acme) — action: confirm platform and send supplier form
- Redwood to provide vendor profile, W-9, and banking details (Redwood - Marissa / Finance) — target: 2026-02-25
- Acme to open supplier record in Coupa/Ariba and confirm Supplier ID (Acme) — target: 2026-03-05
- Legal/MSA redline cycle (Legal teams) — dependency: receipt of vendor form & initial PO terms — target: 2026-03-12
- Go-live (first paid usage) contingent on supplier setup and PO issuance — target: 2026-03-15

Dependencies / notes:
- You mentioned Acme uses Coupa for new suppliers — if so, there may be a required ACH/banking verification step.
- We can provide the vendor profile in Coupa format (attached) and our W-9. If you prefer, Rishi and I can join your procurement call to walk through any fields that are unclear.

Attachments: MAP-Acme-v1.xlsx (draft MAP), Redwood_Vendor_Profile_Coupa.xlsx (vendor profile template), Redwood_W9_2026.pdf (W-9)

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Sarah — confirm Coupa vs Ariba and send the Acme supplier form (if different from the attached).
2) Acme procurement — target vendor activation date 2026-03-05 (is that feasible?).
3) Redwood — provide any missing vendor fields and banking details by 2026-02-25.

If helpful, here’s a short shared MAP doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-Acme-2026

Thanks — we want to keep momentum so legal/finance can do their parts in parallel.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Acme Robotics) - post-demo MAP draft

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the MAP draft. Confirming Acme uses Coupa for supplier onboarding. I’ve attached our Coupa supplier form that we need completed by vendors. A few notes/questions: 

- Please return the completed Coupa supplier form and a W-9 (we need the vendor taxpayer name to match your legal entity).
- We require banking details for ACH setup (bank name, routing, account number) — we can accept a bank letter or voided check in lieu of raw account numbers if that’s required for your finance policy.
- Our target for activating Redwood in Coupa is 2026-03-05 to align with the March engineering window; can Redwood commit to providing completed form + W-9 by 2026-02-25 so we have time to validate?
- If there are any third-party sub-processing questions (where data will be hosted) our security team may follow up with a short questionnaire but that should be a separate thread.

Attached: Acme_Coupa_Vendor_Form.docx

If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk the form.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Robotics
sarah.jenkins@acmerobotics.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmerobotics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Acme Robotics) - post-demo MAP draft

Thanks Sarah — quick confirmation from Redwood side. We can meet the 2026-02-25 deliverable for the completed Coupa form and a signed W-9. Monica (cc’d) from Finance will provide the ACH details and a bank letter if needed.

Updated responsibilities and short checklist (for MAP update):
- Redwood (Marissa / Rishi): fill and return Acme_Coupa_Vendor_Form.docx; provide W-9; provide vendor contact & billing email — due 2026-02-25
- Redwood (Monica Patel): provide ACH/bank letter and vendor remit instructions — due 2026-02-25
- Acme (Sarah / procurement): validate form and provide Supplier ID in Coupa — target 2026-03-05
- Redwood Legal / Acme Legal: exchange MSA redlines once supplier record and initial PO terms are visible — start by 2026-03-06

Rishi

Sarah — thanks, that all sounds good. We’ve attached the completed Coupa vendor profile and our W-9 for Acme’s records (see attached). Monica will follow up with the bank letter via a secure channel (we typically send ACH paperwork via our finance SFTP).

Quick updated MAP milestones (finalizing targets):
- 2026-02-25: Redwood to return completed Coupa form, W-9, bank letter (Marissa / Monica)
- 2026-03-05: Acme to confirm Supplier ID & supplier activation in Coupa (Sarah / procurement)
- 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-12: Legal review and MSA redline (legal teams)
- 2026-03-15: Target first PO / go-live (mutual)

Can you confirm the point-of-contact for supplier verification, and whether you’ll accept the bank letter via secure SFTP or prefer a different channel? Also please confirm the Coupa Supplier ID once you create it so we can map invoices correctly.

If useful, we’re available for a 20-minute handoff call on Thu 02/26 or Fri 02/27 — happy to join whoever is running the vendor intake at Acme.

Thanks again — excited to move forward.

Best,
Marissa
